title: Youtube
description: x-youtube embeds a YouTube video from videoId or a full url as a responsive player that keeps its aspect ratio.

url.description: A full YouTube watch or share URL. The id is extracted from it, so use this OR `videoId`, not both.

videoId.description: The 11-character YouTube id — the `v=` value in a watch URL. Use this OR `url`.

controls.description: Show YouTube's own player controls. Without them the video can only be driven by script.

autoplay.description: Begin playing on load. Needs `muted`, since browsers block autoplay with sound.
autoplay.visualReason: A player URL parameter: starts playback on load. The embedded frame looks the same.

muted.description: Start with audio silenced. Required for `autoplay` to be permitted.
muted.visualReason: A player URL parameter: starts with sound off. The embedded frame looks the same.

loop.description: Restart from the beginning when playback ends.
loop.visualReason: A player URL parameter: restarts the video when it ends. The embedded frame looks the same.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
